stem: Based on this list, which statement would John Jay have MOST supported?

options.label: A
options.text: Promotion of sectionalism is a priority of government.

options.label: B
options.text: State laws should carry more weight than national laws.

options.label: C
options.text: Liberty is best protected by a strong central government.

options.label: D
options.text: Popular sovereignty allows states the right to legalize slavery.

visual_elements:
Accomplishments of John Jay
• President of the Second Continental Congress
• First Secretary of Foreign Affairs
• One of three authors of The Federalist Papers
• First chief justice of the U.S. Supreme Court
